messages:
mira-se: Quick sync — customer (fintech) asking if we can run a POC fully offline. Main asks: what's the minimal installer footprint, ability to do delta upgrades, and offline license activation. Also pricing impact if they want 3-month POC on Dedicated/private. @josh-se any build constraints?

josh-se: We can do an offline bundle. Minimal footprint depends on model size, but for small LLM + runtime expect ~8-12GB for the operator + runtime images. Model artifacts are separate — can be shipped as quantized weights.

ara-eng: +1. For POC I'd recommend our minibundle flow: operator image + config + signed artifacts. Delta updates supported via chunked bundles (rsync-like manifest). Upgrade cadence we support: patch (weekly), minor (monthly), major (quarterly) — but for air-gapped customers we can queue signed deltas on-demand.

mira-se: Great — does that require kicking support to sign each delta? What's time to sign?

ara-eng: Signing is automated but needs release approval. For POC we can pre-sign 2-3 deltas in the first week, typical turnaround 1 business day for signed artifacts once POC plan approved.

kyle-ops: Important ops note: offline install will need outbound to the license activation endpoint for first activation unless you want token-based manual activation. We can support a one-time activation via signed license file if legal approves. Port-wise we need: access to internal registries (no egress if using bundle), and 6443/10250 only internal.

sam-legal: Manual license activation via signed file is OK for short POCs. Need to confirm their internal retention policy for signed artifacts and ensure EULA acceptance. Also they requested KMS/HSM support — we need to verify their HSM vendor for key import.

mira-se: Pricing question — if they run a 3-month POC on private, any discounts or trial capacity?

josh-se: Typically we offer trial credits for Hosted only. For Dedicated/private POCs we do time-limited waived platform fee and prorated infra charges; commercial discount depends on ARR expectations. I'll draft a quote.

mira-se: Customer also flagged security questionnaire Q5 (artifact signing) and Q12 (SBOM). @ara-eng can we produce SBOM for the minibundle?

ara-eng: Yes, SBOM generated per bundle (CycloneDX). We can also include a signed manifest and verification script. Example manifest snippet:
```
{
  "bundle": "minibundle-v1",
  "sha256": "<hash>",
  "components": ["runtime:1.4.2","operator:0.9.1"]
}
```

deploy-bot: artifact uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/airgap/minibundle-v1.tar.gz (signed)

kyle-ops: Two enterprise blockers to flag: 1) HSM import process (needs on-prem procedure), 2) support SLA for offline upgrades — switchover requires local operator run which devs must be comfortable with. Those can be mitigated but will require runbook + shadow on-call.

mira-se: Thanks. Next steps: @josh-se to produce a POC quote + list of pre-signed deltas. @ara-eng to prepare minibundle SBOM + verification script. @sam-legal to draft manual activation CLA for POC. I'll sync with customer and set a follow-up. :thumbsup:
